measurement_policy.clock: std.time.monotonic_nanos inside each Spectra sample; excludes CLI startup and compile
measurement_policy.aggregation: median and nearest-rank p95 across timed samples; median of per-group medians is exposed through group samples
measurement_policy.correctness: each sample checks lengths, keys, order, empty-state behavior and checksums in the timed fixture; Rust storage checks the expected sum
measurement_policy.capacity: actual runtime backing capacity queried before and after operations; BitSet capacity reports addressable bit positions; storage probe reports backing bytes
measurement_policy.string_key_normalization: derived from timed operation count and key length: each non-empty string key operation creates an owned key and copies key bytes; allocator metadata and process-wide allocations are not measured

vector_fast_abi_comparison.baseline_provenance: Transcribed from the first complete R-3308 release-gate output immediately before the VectorPush/VectorGet fast ABI change. The earlier full JSON report and binary metadata were replaced by the post-change report, so the original binary hash and source-tree fingerprint are unavailable.
vector_fast_abi_comparison.workload: indexed append and traversal; List<T> is the per-run reference
vector_fast_abi_comparison.ratio_semantics: List median operation latency / Vector median operation latency; values above 1 mean Vector<T> is faster
vector_fast_abi_comparison.reduction_method: estimated from the before/after List-to-Vector ratio; assumes List<T> reference latency is stable between release runs

vector_t_go_no_go.method: isolated optimized Rust storage probe; not Spectra ABI wall-clock
vector_t_go_no_go.gate: all three independent groups must show at least 10% Vec speedup and Vec backing bytes must be no more than 5% above VecDeque
